canonical_project: Baiyin District Artificial Intelligence Open Platform / Intelligent Computing Center
owner: Baiyin District Big Data Center; China Mobile Gansu Baiyin; SenseTime
notes: Baiyin District government公告 for stages 2-3 says the project is led by Baiyin District Big Data Center, jointly won by China Mobile Gansu Baiyin and SenseTime, at RMB 49.96864 million, located at 262 Jianshe East Road, and includes an AI open platform, algorithm warehouse, big data platform, general data services, scenario applications, intelligent computing center and streaming servers.
